Idea to shipped feature with Kiro in 6 steps (spec-driven development)

Six steps to take a feature from idea to shipped with Kiro.

1. Describe it - Tell Kiro the feature in plain words.
2. Get requirements - Kiro writes requirements.md with user stories.
3. Review like a contract - Read every acceptance criterion before you move on.
4. Check the design - design.md maps schemas, APIs and diagrams.
5. Get the task list - tasks.md breaks the work into sequenced steps.
6. Run and review - Run the tasks, then review every diff.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/specs/

Which step surprised you? Comment its number. theAIgurukul posts a Kiro tip every day - subscribe.
